summary: This is user-facing documentation explaining how to run an action and what command-line flags are available. It lists three optional flags the user can pass: one for debugging, one to disable colors, and one for verbose output.

explanations.1: The {{ command }} is a placeholder that will be replaced with the actual command users should type when this documentation is rendered.
explanations.5: The backticks around --debug mark it as a literal command-line flag that users type exactly as written.
explanations.6: ANSI colors are special codes that terminals use to display text in different colors; this flag lets users turn that off if their terminal doesn't support it or they prefer plain text.
